subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw support trusted external workspace agent-config discovery in core, or keep agent registration explicit and prioritize zero-restart explicit agent management?
rationale: The remaining work changes config shape, filesystem trust boundaries, gateway agent registration, and live routing semantics, and source inspection does not show a maintainer-approved discovery boundary to implement mechanically.

options.title: Prefer explicit zero-restart management
options.body: Keep registration through agents.add/create/update/delete and solve the user pain through safer hot-load or hot-reload paths for explicit agent and binding changes.

options.title: Design core trusted discovery
options.body: Accept a core discovery feature only after specifying trusted roots, glob limits, realpath and symlink policy, precedence, reload lifecycle, audit output, docs, and upgrade tests.

options.title: Keep scanning outside core
options.body: Route workspace scanning to operator tooling or plugins unless a missing core API blocks safe explicit registration.

recommendation.title: Prefer explicit zero-restart management
recommendation.body: Keep registration through agents.add/create/update/delete and solve the user pain through safer hot-load or hot-reload paths for explicit agent and binding changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the best available owner signal from recent release/current-code history around the affected config and gateway surfaces.
